name: Banco Pine S.A.
summary: Banco Pine S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in Brazil. The company engages in commercial, investment, credit, financing, foreign exchange, and leasing businesses. It is also involved in consulting; securities distribution; real estate; business intermediation; and commercialization of environmental assets. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
